raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What
`smallm_fp8_blockscale_gfx950` imports its HIP build/launch helpers from `sglang.kernels.jit.utils.hipcc` (`check_hip`, `hip_lib`, `hipcc_path`, `HipKernel`) instead of the private names that no longer exist in `smallm_moe_gfx950`.

## Why
#45112 moved `_check`, `_hip_lib`, `_hipcc` and `_Kernel` out of `smallm_moe_gfx950` into `jit/utils/hipcc.py` under the new names. #42229 added this module against the old location and merged a day later, so importing it fails:

```
File ".../kernels/ops/gemm/smallm_fp8_blockscale_gfx950/__init__.py", line 10, in <module>
ImportError: cannot import name '_check' from 'sglang.kernels.ops.moe.smallm_moe_gfx950'
```

`aiter_w8a8_block_fp8_linear` imports it on gfx950, so FP8 block-scale dense linears fail there. Three tests in `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x` have failed with this since: `test_smallm_fp8_blockscale_gfx950.py`, `test_dsv4_dense_mxscale_gfx95.py` and `test_fp8_bpreshuffle_dense_linear_mi35x.py`. Example: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39599109770/job/119218874753

The helpers are the same code under the new names; this is the change #45112 made to the sibling `smallm_fp8_gfx950`.

## Test plan
- [x] `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x` partition 0 on rocm10 and rocm720: `test_dsv4_dense_mxscale_gfx95.py` and `test_fp8_bpreshuffle_dense_linear_mi35x.py` pass, all 32 files green: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39687298904
- [x] All lanes (rocm10 / rocm724 / rocm720), both partitions, with #45507 and #45728 for the other failures in this suite: every job ran all 32 files and passed, including `test_smallm_fp8_blockscale_gfx950.py`, `test_dsv4_dense_mxscale_gfx95.py` and `test_fp8_bpreshuffle_dense_linear_mi35x.py`. https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39718424554


<!-- pr-states:start -->
---
### CI States

Latest PR Test (Base): <!-- slot:pr-test:start -->:x: [Run #39687377997](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39687377997)<!-- slot:pr-test:end -->
Latest PR Test (Extra): <!-- slot:pr-test-extra:start -->:warning: **Not enabled** -- add `run-ci-extra` label to opt in.<!-- slot:pr-test-extra:end -->
Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): <!-- slot:pr-test-amd:start -->:heavy_minus_sign: **No AMD PR run found for this commit**.<!-- slot:pr-test-amd:end -->
<!-- pr-states:end -->

nodes.body:
Thanks for catching this! #42229 landed right after #45112 moved these helpers and I missed the rename. I made the same change locally, and on MI355X it imports fine and `test_smallm_fp8_blockscale_gfx950.py` passes. 

LGTM. This should clear the MI355X nightly failures (DeepSeek, GLM-5.3, MiniMax-M3).

@HaiShaw this needs a `python/sglang/kernels` code-owner approval to merge; it already has two approvals (chuyeh, 1am9trash).

CI status:

- The fix is validated on `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x`, rocm10 / rocm724 / rocm720, both partitions, all 32 files passing per job, including `test_smallm_fp8_blockscale_gfx950.py`, `test_dsv4_dense_mxscale_gfx95.py` and `test_fp8_bpreshuffle_dense_linear_mi35x.py`: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39718424554 (run together with #45507, now merged, and #45728 for the other failures in that suite).
- The red checks on this PR are not from this diff:
  - `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x`: this PR's run started before #45507 merged and stopped at the two test failures #45507 fixes, before reaching the tests above.
  - `stage-b-test-large-8-gpu-mi35x-disaggregation-amd`: `test_nixl_transfer_engine_e2e.py` was failing on every scheduled `main` run at the time; it is green on `main` again as of today.
  - `base-c-test-8-gpu-b300`: the runner could not download a gated HF model for `test_muse_spark_12_b300_pd.py`; `base-c-test-4-gpu-gb300` was skipped by fail-fast after it. `base-c-test-8-gpu-h20` runs on NVIDIA and does not import this gfx950-only module.
  - `*-extra-finish` / `call-gate`: the extra suites, not labeled for this PR.

@HaiShaw @DarkSharpness @BBuf @celve @HydraQYH @yuan-luo @Lzy17 could one of you take a look? The missing approval is a `python/sglang/kernels` code owner. It is a four-name import fix (the rename from #45112) that unbreaks `smallm_fp8_blockscale_gfx950` on gfx950; CI details are in the comment above.

LGTM.
Align the func path/name after the refactor.

detail.title: [Fix] [AMD] kernels: Import the HIP launch helpers from jit.utils.hipcc in smallm_fp8_blockscale_gfx950

files.patch:
@@ -7,7 +7,7 @@
 
 import torch
 
-from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.smallm_moe_gfx950 import _check, _hip_lib, _hipcc, _Kernel
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils.hipcc import HipKernel, check_hip, hip_lib, hipcc_path
 
 _SRC = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "smallm_fp8_blockscale_gemm.hip")
 # (N, K) -> (max M, N tiles/block, K steps/wave, waves), first match wins.
@@ -49,24 +49,26 @@ def try_smallm_fp8_bs_linear(x, WQ, w_scale):
         return None
     if _mod is None:
         co = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), "k.co")
-        cmd = [_hipcc(), "--genco", "--offload-arch=gfx950", "-O3", "-o", co, _SRC]
+        cmd = [hipcc_path(), "--genco", "--offload-arch=gfx950", "-O3", "-o", co, _SRC]
         try:
             subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, capture_output=True)
             _mod = ctypes.c_void_p()
-            _check(_hip_lib().hipModuleLoad(ctypes.byref(_mod), co.encode()), "load")
+            check_hip(hip_lib().hipModuleLoad(ctypes.byref(_mod), co.encode()), "load")
         except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError, RuntimeError) as e:
             _mod = False
             print(f"[smallm_fp8_bs] disabled: {e}", flush=True)
             return None
     key = ((M + 15) // 16, *cfg)
-    hip, fn = _hip_lib(), _fns.get(key)
+    hip, fn = hip_lib(), _fns.get(key)
     if fn is None:
-        fn = _fns[key] = _Kernel(_mod, "smallm_fp8_bs_m{}_n{}_s{}_w{}".format(*key)).fn
+        fn = _fns[key] = HipKernel(
+            _mod, "smallm_fp8_bs_m{}_n{}_s{}_w{}".format(*key)
+        ).fn
     out = torch.empty(M, N, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=x.device)
     args = Args(*(t.data_ptr() for t in (x, WQ, w_scale, out)), M, N, x.stride(0))
     params = (ctypes.c_void_p * 1)(ctypes.addressof(args))
     stream = torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream
     grid, block = N // (16 * key[1]), 64 * key[3]
     rc = hip.hipModuleLaunchKernel(fn, grid, 1, 1, block, 1, 1, 0, stream, params, None)
-    _check(rc, "launch")
+    check_hip(rc, "launch")
     return out
